12048-our-little-korean-cousin.title: Our Little Korean Cousin
12048-our-little-korean-cousin.creator: H. Lee M. Pike
12048-our-little-korean-cousin.description: A book by H. Lee M. Pike. Perhaps Yung Pak's father did not say much, but any one could have seen by his face that he was tremendously pleased. He was a very dignified man, and his manner was nearly always calm, no matter how stirred up he might have felt in his mind. This was one of the rare occasions when his face expanded into a smile, and he immediately made a generous offering of rice to the household tablets.

arxiv-2103-11862.title: Resilient Control under Quantization and Denial-of-Service: Co-designing a Deadbeat Controller and Transmission Protocol Thanks: This work was supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grants 61925303, 62088101, U20B2073, 61720106011, and the National Key R & \& D P
arxiv-2103-11862.creator: Wenjie Liu, Jian Sun, Gang Wang
arxiv-2103-11862.description: Abstract This paper is concerned with the problem of stabilizing continuous-time linear time-invariant systems subject to quantization and Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks. In this context, two DoS-induced challenges emerge with the design of resilient encoding schemes, namely, the coupling between encoding strategies of different signals, and the synchronization between the encoder and decoder.

arxiv-2105-04952.title: Influence of chiral asymmetry on phase structure of the two-color quark matter
arxiv-2105-04952.creator: T. G. Khunjua 1 , K. G. Klimenko 2 , and R. N. Zhokhov 2,3
arxiv-2105-04952.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by T. G. Khunjua 1 , K. G. Klimenko 2 , and R. N. Zhokhov 2,3. In this paper the influence of chiral chemical potential μ 5 \mu_{5} on the phenomenon of diquark condensation and phase structure of dense quark matter altogether is contemplated in the framework of effective two-color and two-flavor Nambu–Jona-Lasinio model. The nonzero values of baryon μ B \mu_{B} , isospin μ I \mu_{I} and chiral isospin μ I ​ 5 \mu_{I5} chemical potentials are also taken into account.

arxiv-2405-18192.title: Dalitz-plot analysis of B ± → K ± ​ K + ​ K − B^{\pm}\to K^{\pm}K^{+}K^{-} decays
arxiv-2405-18192.creator: L. Leśniak and P. Żenczykowski
arxiv-2405-18192.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by L. Leśniak and P. Żenczykowski. We study B ± → K ± ​ K + ​ K − B^{\pm}\to K^{\pm}K^{+}K^{-} decays using the QCD factorization model with final state interactions between K + K^{+} and K − K^{-} mesons taken into account. The parameters of the model are fitted to the data of the B ​ A ​ B ​ A ​ R BABAR and LHCb collaborations.

arxiv-2406-02567.title: Tunable drag drop via flow-induced snap-through in origami
arxiv-2406-02567.creator: Rishabh Nain, Tom Marzin, Sophie Ramananarivo
arxiv-2406-02567.description: Abstract We leverage the snap-through response of a bistable origami mechanism to induce a discontinuous evolution of drag with flow speed. The transition between equilibrium states is passively actuated by airflow, and we demonstrate that large shape reconfiguration over a small increment of flow velocity leads to a pronounced and sudden drop in drag.

arxiv-2506-01956.title: Rapid and accurate numerical evolution of linear cosmological perturbations with non-cold relics
arxiv-2506-01956.creator: Nanoom Lee, José Luis Bernal, Sven Günther, Lingyuan Ji, Marc Kamionkowski
arxiv-2506-01956.description: Abstract We describe the implementation of a new approach to the numerical evaluation of the effects of non-cold relics on the evolution of cosmological perturbations. The Boltzmann hierarchies used to compute the contributions of these relics to the stress-energy tensor are replaced with a set of integral equations.

arxiv-2507-01856.title: Investigating the Fermi-Hubbard model by the Tensor-Backflow method
arxiv-2507-01856.creator: Xiao Liang
arxiv-2507-01856.description: Abstract Recently, a variational wave-function based on the tensor representation of backflow corrections has achieved state-of-the-art energy precision in solving Fermi-Hubbard-type models tensorbackflow . However, the Fermi-Hubbard model is very challenging to solve, and the validity of a method relies on investigating the ground state’s physical property.

arxiv-2512-10250.title: Time-Averaged Drift Approximations are Inconsistent for Inference in Drift Diffusion Models
arxiv-2512-10250.creator: Sicheng Liu, Alexander Fengler, Michael J. Frank, Matthew T. Harrison
arxiv-2512-10250.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sicheng Liu, Alexander Fengler, Michael J. Frank, Matthew T. Harrison. Drift diffusion models (DDMs) have found widespread use in computational neuroscience and other fields. They model evidence accumulation in simple decision tasks as a stochastic process drifting towards a decision barrier. In models where the drift rate is both time-varying within a trial and variable across trials, the high computational cost for accurate likelihood evaluation has led to the common use of a computationally convenient surrogate for parameter inference, the time-averaged drift approximation (TADA).

britannica-1911-ivarr-beinlausi.description: Article 'Ivarr, Beinlausi' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. great Viking chieftain, is known in English and Continental annals as Inuaer, Ingwar or Hingwar. He was one of the Danish leaders in the Sheppey expedition of 855 and was perhaps present at the siege of York in 867. The chief incident in his life was his share in the martyrdom of St Edmund in 870.

pmc-11458677.creator: Carla Ida Ripamonti, Cosimo Chelazzi
pmc-11458677.description: the significance of hope for both patients and their caregivers, along with strategies for sustaining, encouraging, and nurturing hope. HCPs may employ validated questionnaires, available in multiple languages, to screen and assess physical, emotional, as well as existential/spiritual, social, and financial needs in a comprehensive, holistic approach [2–4].

pmc-11689444.title: WE’RE ALL BORN NAKED AND THE REST IS DRAG: EXPLORING DRAMA THERAPY WITH AGING DRAG ARTISTS
pmc-11689444.creator: Camryn Hafner, Jahmar Ortiz
pmc-11689444.description: Due to barriers of mental health stigma, limited accessibility, and ageism, older adults are severely underrepresented among those currently engaging in mental health treatment (Saunders et al., 2021). For older drag artists, additional barriers exist in the lineage of invalidation, pathologization, and discrimination which Western psychology and mental health systems have traditionally afforded gender-expansive individuals (Brewster et al., 2019).

pmc-12413521.title: Factors Affecting the Health-Related Quality of Life in Taiwanese Adolescent Baseball Players: A Prospective Longitudinal Study
pmc-12413521.creator: Po-Cheng Chen, Hou-Tsung Chen, Kuan-Ting Wu, Yu-Chi Huang, Nai-Lun Lee, Chi-Fa Hung, Wen-Yi Chou
pmc-12413521.description: Background:Adolescent baseball players often experience throwing arm complaints from the repetitive activity of baseball, which can affect performance and overall well-being. More focus is needed on their psychological and social challenges in order to achieve better treatment outcomes.Purpose:To investigate changes in the health-related quality of life (HRQOL) among adolescent baseball players in Taiwan and identify the factors that influence HRQOL.

pmc-12464691.title: Epileptogenic zone-targeting nanoparticle drug delivery system for antiseizure medication
pmc-12464691.creator: Honglu Ping, Qi Zhang, Xiaojie Chen, Yi Wang, Di Wu, Jianhong Wang, Jun Zhang
pmc-12464691.description: Epilepsy is a chronic neurological disorder affecting over 65 million people worldwide, characterized by abnormal excessive excitation of neuronal networks. Traditional antiseizure medications (ASMs), such as phenytoin (PHT), have limited therapeutic efficacy due to poor blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration and off-target toxicity.

pmc-12513993.title: Cardiomyocyte lncRNA Cpat maintains cardiac homeostasis and mitochondria function by targeting citrate synthase acetylation
pmc-12513993.creator: Fan Yu, Jingsi Duan, Zhengyin Lou, Guo-Ping Shi, Fuzhe Gong, Lingfeng Zhong, Derong Chen, Li Xu, Tingting Hong, Xinyang Hu, Jinghai Chen, Jian’an Wang, Deling Yin
pmc-12513993.description: Myocardial energy metabolism disorders are essential pathophysiology in sepsis-associated myocardial injury. Yet, the underlying mechanisms involving impaired mitochondrial respiratory function upon myocardial injury remain poorly understood. Here we identify an unannotated and cardiomyocyte-enriched long non-coding RNA, Cpat (cardiac-protector-associated transcript), that plays an important role in regulating the dynamics of cardiomyocyte mitochondrial tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle.

pmc-12688497.title: Is induction therapy optimal for all patients with locally advanced distal esophagus adenocarcinoma?—The impact of age and co-morbidities on treatment and outcomes
pmc-12688497.creator: Mark F. Berry, Chris Aboujudom, Michelle Chan, Douglas Z. Liou
pmc-12688497.description: BackgroundThe benefits to induction chemoradiation for esophageal adenocarcinoma patients are established, but optimal management for patients who cannot tolerate trimodality therapy is not clear. This study tested the hypothesis that subsets of high-risk patients have better survival with primary surgery compared to induction therapy.

pmc-12872902.title: Robotics total knee arthroplasty: is an image-based the only solution?
pmc-12872902.creator: Alessandro El Motassime, Lorenzo Fulli, Luca Andriollo, Corrado Ciatti, Rudy Sangaletti, Francesco Benazzo, Stefano Marco Paolo Rossi
pmc-12872902.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Robotic-assisted total knee arthroplasty (TKA) significantly enhances surgical precision and alignment accuracy. While traditional robotic systems rely on preoperative imaging, imageless technology has emerged as a viable alternative, leading to a reduction in costs, radiation exposure, and logistical challenges. This narrative review aims to evaluate the efficacy and reliability of imageless robotic-assisted TKA, specifically assessing its accuracy in component positioning, functional outcomes, and potential advantages over image-based systems.

pmc-13144879.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2288 PATIENT- AND DISEASE CHARACTERISTICS AND PHARMACOLOGICAL APPROACHES IN PRIMARY ANGIITIS OF THE CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM (PACNS): REPORT OF TWENTY-FIVE DUTCH CASES
pmc-13144879.creator: Kim Mahabali, Willeke Westendorp, Diederik van de Beek, Matthijs Brouwer, Jonathan Coutinho
pmc-13144879.description: Background and aimsPrimary angiitis of the central nervous system (PACNS) is a rare, severe form of vasculitis limited to the brain, spinal cord and meninges. We evaluated patient- and disease characteristics, our pharmacological approach and outcome in patients with PACNS.MethodsIn a retrospective, single-center cohort study, we analyzed consecutive adult patients who met the diagnostic criteria for PACNS.

pmc-13147993.title: Protocol for mapping murine myeloid bone marrow progenitors and their differentiation into CD103+ cDC1s and CD301b+ cDC2s
pmc-13147993.creator: Damir Vurnek, Giorgi Tchitashvili, Anna Seichter, Tomislav Vuletic, Isabel Heß, Lizi Trapaidze, Lukas Heger, Nounagnon Romaric Tochoedo, Christian HK Lehmann, Bart N Lambrecht, Diana Dudziak, Lukas Amon
pmc-13147993.description: SummaryEx vivo differentiation platforms have a long-standing history for studying dendritic cell (DC) ontogeny and function. Here, we present a protocol for differentiating bona fide DCs from murine bone marrow. We describe steps for bone marrow preparation, followed by ex vivo differentiation of DC subtypes resembling either lymphoid or mucosal tissue DC phenotypes.

pmc-13340266.title: NoisyFlow: differentially private optimal transport using neural networks for secure biomedical data sharing across multiple institutions
pmc-13340266.creator: Yunyang Li, Nikhil Khandekar, Skylar Wang, Varada Khanna, Julian Sanker, Mark B Gerstein
pmc-13340266.description: MotivationBiomedical models improve when trained on data pooled across institutions, but sensitive patient records (e.g. genomics, clinical data, and medical images) are difficult to share due to privacy constraints. Moreover, data collected at different sites often have shifted distributions because of covariate differences (including batch effects), so privacy-preserving sharing alone cannot simply resolve cross-site mismatch.

pmc-13514935.title: Functional Biomaterials and 3D Bioprinting Approaches for Temporomandibular Joint Reconstruction: A Narrative Review
pmc-13514935.creator: Dobromira Shopova, Svetlin Aleksandrov, Mariya Ivanova Hristozova
pmc-13514935.description: The temporomandibular joint (TMJ) is a highly specialized synovial joint responsible for essential functions such as mastication, speech, and swallowing. Owing to its unique anatomical organization, complex biomechanics, and heterogeneous tissue composition, regeneration of the TMJ remains one of the greatest challenges in craniofacial reconstructive surgery.
